1.en: Then God spoke to Moses directly.

2.en: son of Uri son of Hur

3.ja: ואכמלת פיה עלם מן ענד אללה
3.en: and I have made complete in him a knowledge from God

4.en: in the working of gold and silver and copper,

5.en: and in the cutting of gems for setting,
and in the carpentry of wood,
and in the making of all the rest of the crafts.

6.ja: ואנא פקד צ'ממת אליה. אהליאב אבן אחיסמך מן סבט דן
6.en: And I, for my part, have joined to him Oholiab son of Ahisamakh of the tribe of Dan;
6.he: וַאֲנִי הִנֵּה נָתַתִּי אִתּוֹ אֵת אָהֳלִיאָב בֶּן-אֲחִיסָמָךְ לְמַטֵּה-דָן

6.ja: ופי קלב כל חכים קד געלת חכמה
6.en: and in the heart of every skilled man I have placed wisdom,
that they may make all that I have commanded you:

7.en: and the ark of the testimony,
and the cover which is upon it,
and all the rest of the vessels of the tent,

8.en: and the table and its vessels,
and the pure lampstand and all its vessels,

9.en: and the altar of the offering and all its vessels,
and the laver and its base,

10.en: and the sacred garments for Aaron the imām,
and the garments of his sons for the imāmate,

11.en: and the incense of the resins for the sacred place —
according to all that I commanded you, they shall make.

12.en: And God said to Moses, saying:

13.ja: ואנת פמר בני אסראיל וקל להם
13.en: 'And you — command the sons of Israel and say to them:
As for My sabbaths, you shall keep them;
for they are a sign between Me and you throughout your generations,
13.he: כִּי אוֹת הִוא בֵּינִי וּבֵינֵיכֶם לְדֹרֹתֵיכֶם

13.en: that they may know that I am God who sanctifies you.

14.en: for it is consecrated to you;
and he who profanes it shall surely be put to death —

14.ja: וכל מן יעמל פיהא עמלא. ינקטע ד'אלך אלאנסאן מן קומה
14.en: and anyone who performs labor on it, that person shall be cut off from his people.
14.he: כִּי כָּל-הָעֹשֶׂה בָהּ מְלָאכָה וְנִכְרְתָה הַנֶּפֶשׁ הַהִוא מִקֶּרֶב עַמֶּיהָ

15.en: Six days shall the crafts be done,

15.ja: ופי אליום אלסאבע. עטלה הי סבת מקדסה ללה
15.en: but on the seventh day there is a cessation: it is a Sabbath consecrated to God;
15.he: וּבַיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי שַׁבַּת שַׁבָּתוֹן קֹדֶשׁ לַיהוָה

15.ja: וכל מן עמל עמלא פיהא יקתל
15.en: whoever performs labor on it shall be put to death.
15.he: כָּל-הָעֹשֶׂה מְלָאכָה בְּיוֹם הַשַּׁבָּת מוֹת יוּמָת

16.en: And the sons of Israel shall keep the Sabbath
and abide by it throughout their generations —

17.ja: אד' הי עלאמה ביני ובין בני אסראיל
17.en: For it is a sign between Me and the sons of Israel:
17.he: בֵּינִי וּבֵין בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל--אוֹת הִוא לְעֹלָם

17.ja: לאן פי סתה' איאם. צנע אללה אלסמאואת ואלארץ'
17.en: for in six days God made the heavens and the earth,
17.he: כִּי-שֵׁשֶׁת יָמִים עָשָׂה יְהוָה אֶת-הַשָּׁמַיִם וְאֶת-הָאָרֶץ

17.en: and on the seventh day He desisted from it and gave it rest.'

18.ja: ת'ם דפע אלי' מוסי. חין פרג' מן מכ'אטבתה עלי' גבל סיני
18.en: Then He delivered to Moses — when He had finished speaking with him upon Mount Sinai —
18.he: וַיִּתֵּן אֶל-מֹשֶׁה כְּכַלֹּתוֹ לְדַבֵּר אִתּוֹ בְּהַר סִינַי

18.en: the two tablets of the testimony:
tablets of stone, written by the power of God.
